title: Vandenberg and Malmstrom as recurring UFO hotspots
place_text: Vandenberg AFB, California; Malmstrom AFB, Montana

tellings.quote: It's one of these places like Malmstrom uh you know base in Montana where throughout the years you have recurring patterns of UFO sightings.

plain: Vandenberg, an Air Force base in California, and Malmstrom, an Air Force base in Montana, are places where UFO sightings keep coming back over the years, Michels says. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a nuclear missile guard who says he was abducted. If true, it would mean the sightings cluster around military sites rather than falling at random.
